wholePhysicalScope: The surviving Parliament House exterior at College Green in May 2024, including its three porticoes, quadrant screen walls, slate and copper roofs and two open interior courts.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the curved front, three porticoes, open courtyards and roof silhouette. Near levels show recesses, column mouldings and the roof details.
limitations: The former Parliament House is modeled in its May 2024 bank-era appearance. The 2024 Foster Place photograph and earlier south engraving control visible street elevations.

The outline and two internal courtyards follow the named mapped building. Roof sections, lesser elevations, carvings and the east portico use the descriptions in the heritage record and estimated proportions.
The original composite elevation field is preserved and the historic ground contact is approximate.
The exact Qualla references stay in the local image corpus with their hashes and provenance in the model record.
